content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after each Save click on the cap / floor screen, a visible error event fires, and the user then edits Trade Date, Counterparty, or Notional and clicks Save again, with the same error appearing again. The error seems to persist or re-trigger after the edits, and no event shows which field it refers to or that it cleared.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor screen, make the Save button's validation error name the offending field inline next to Counterparty, Notional, or Trade Date, and clear that field's error as soon as its input changes, so a user can see which value Save is rejecting before retrying.", "cited_event_ids": ["388", "app:45", "413", "313", "294", "435", "app:52", "307:a329", "306"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text or target field of the visible error messages is not in the events.", "Whether the error cleared after edits is not recorded; no error-cleared event kind exists.", "Whether the edited values were the ones Save rejected is not shown.", "The window covers only one of the six affected sessions; the other five are not verified.", "The first Save click (event 176) in this window has no following error event, so the loop pattern is only shown from the later saves."]}
